business_problem: BestSecret needed a more stable and scalable event backbone for campaign launches and webshop experiences because legacy batch and on-prem Kafka operations slowed data availability, strained a lean team, and made it harder to react to customer demand in real time.
solution_summary: BestSecret turned Confluent Cloud into the central messaging platform for its off-price fashion marketplace after proving out Kafka with lower-risk use cases. The platform aggregates product descriptions, images, categorization, and search-tagging data from multiple systems in real time and sends the joined output into the webshop through sink connectors. Legacy data is also brought into the same streaming backbone through CDC so operational metrics and cross-domain business data are available from Kafka topics to any team that needs them. BestSecret uses ready-made connectors for Snowflake, Elastic, and Postgres to move data into downstream sink systems without months of custom development, while the managed service sharply reduces the administrative burden on a small platform team. This architecture supports faster campaign launches, new marketplace initiatives such as Curated Platform, and rapid experimentation on new web and app concepts.

solution_components.name: Confluent Cloud
solution_components.role: Acts as BestSecret's central messaging platform and source of real-time operational business metrics.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Receives streaming business data through a ready-to-use sink connector.

solution_components.name: Elastic Sink connector
solution_components.role: Publishes joined product data from multiple systems into the webshop experience.

solution_components.name: Postgres
solution_components.role: Serves as one of the downstream sink systems connected through Confluent's out-of-the-box connectors.

data_flow: Product and operational data is aggregated in real time from multiple source systems, streamed through Confluent Cloud, exposed in Kafka topics for internal teams, and then delivered to the webshop and sink systems such as Elastic, Snowflake, and Postgres.
business_outcome: BestSecret reduced operational overhead, sped campaign and marketplace launches from months to days, improved app and website responsiveness, and created a real-time data foundation that supports growth into new markets and fulfillment capacity.
architecture_clues: BestSecret uses CDC to bring legacy-system data into Confluent Cloud alongside newer streams.
The streaming model emphasizes domain separation so teams can publish data once and reuse it across the company.
Sink connectors move data into the webshop and analytical stores without custom-built transfer logic.
